title: Opening the Create Bot box resets the create state even while an earlier createBot is in flight
trigger: Press Create, close the box with Esc while Creating (close_bot_create keeps the state on purpose), then open another tg://newbot link or managed-bot button before the answer
effect: open_bot_create calls reset_create_bot unconditionally: stage goes Creating -> Editing and generation is bumped, so the answer no longer matches submission.generation; the bot exists on the server but is never reported, its chat never opens and the keyboard-button share is never answered
fix: reset_create_bot only when !creating(), or keep Creating in the stage and have a new box adopt it

title: A collectible lookup whose send fails is ignored: the tap is silently dead
trigger: Tap a collectible username or phone number while the chats path is inactive or the sender refuses the request
effect: open_collectible_info does `let _ = live.driver.request_collectible_info(lookup)`, request_collectible_info returns Err and stores no lookup, then open_box(CollectibleInfo) runs anyway; the box predicate needs lookup.info(), so nothing opens and no status note is posted (the Failed-lookup note exists only for TDLib errors, via pump_collectible_info)
fix: Match the Result: on Err post StatusNote::error (or store LookupStage::Failed); open the box only on Ok

title: open_collectible_info drops the Err from request_collectible_info
trigger: Tap a collectible username or phone when the chats path is not active or the send fails
effect: let _ = discards ConnectSendError::InvalidRequest or a send error; the tap is silently dead (only a failed answer posts a note)
fix: match the result and post StatusNote::error like pump_collectible_info

title: One launch slot for all chats: a second prepaid launch overwrites another chat's Launching stage
trigger: Start a prepaid giveaway for chat A, close the form (Launching survives for_form), open the form of chat B and confirm its start before A's answer lands. launch_prepaid_giveaway only checks is_launching_for(B) and writes Launching{B}
effect: A's answer no longer matches the slot (request != pending id): A's success is not shown and A's failure never shows its reason; A's form opens as Idle and Start for A is enabled again
fix: A per-chat map `launches: HashMap<ChatId, GiveawayLaunch>` (stage per owner), not one slot with a chat_id inside

title: A failed giveaway-options send leaves the lists Idle: the form says 'not available' with no retry
trigger: Open 'Boosts via Gifts' for a new giveaway while the send of getPremiumGiveawayPaymentOptions or getStarGiveawayPaymentOptions fails (request_giveaway_options result is dropped with `let _`; the driver resets the Fetch to Idle, not Failed)
effect: The prize section shows 'Premium giveaways are not available' (or the Stars equivalent) as if the server refused; nothing offers Retry and nothing re-sends until the form is closed and opened again
fix: Set Fetch::Failed with send_failed_line on a failed send (as invite links do) and draw a Retry row that calls request_giveaway_options

title: Welcome-message pack: a failed load send leaves no Failed stage, so the box shows 'No welcome messages yet' with no Retry
trigger: Open the welcome-message editor while the send of loadChatWelcomeMessages fails (driver Err, e.g. disconnected)
effect: load_welcome_messages only sets a status note; ConnectDriver::load_chat_welcome_messages returns before calling pack.begin(), so the Fetch stays absent/Idle, which the box draws as the empty list (no Retry, unlike join requests)
fix: On send Err mark the pack Failed (as ask_join_requests does) so the Retry row shows; draw Idle as loading, not as empty

title: WelcomeDialog editing: Option<i32> + save: Submit are two fields kept in step by hand; a row switch or Cancel drops an in-flight save
trigger: Edit a welcome message, press Save (Sending), then press Cancel on the row or Edit on another row
effect: editing/save are reset by hand at 4 sites (edit click, cancel, settle edit_gone, settle Done); the Sending Submit is overwritten with Editing, its request is forgotten, the note and error for the edit never show and a second save can go out for the same message
fix: enum Editing { Idle, Row { welcome_id, submit: Submit } } on WelcomeDialog; Cancel and Edit disabled (or refused) while Row.submit is Sending

title: Transfer dialog sticks on 'Checking...' / 'Finding out who becomes the owner...' when the opening requests fail to send
trigger: Open Transfer ownership or the owner Leave box while the connection is not ready (chats_path_active false or send error); the sends are `let _ =` ignored, check is cancelled back to Idle and the owner lookup entry is removed
effect: Confirm step shows 'Checking...' forever (Idle is neither ready, blocked nor error) and the Leave box shows 'Finding out...' forever; no retry until the dialog is reopened
fix: Show Idle/failed send as Fetch::Failed with a Retry, or retry on entering Confirm

title: Pick list treats a loading or failed member list as an empty list
trigger: Open Transfer ownership on a large group: the five member fetches (sends ignored with `let _`) are still Loading, or one failed
effect: Candidate list shows the 'no candidates' empty text while loading and for good after a failure; no spinner, error or retry
fix: Draw Loading/Failed/Empty from the Fetch variants of the member lists, with Retry

title: Tray video sound read stays Reading forever when its continuation is dropped, so Send is refused for good
trigger: Attach an .mp4 to a tray, then within the ffprobe read close the chat window that started it or switch account (ComposerSends and TrayReads outlive both); reopen the tray
effect: check_tray_videos starts the read with spawn_scoped(...).detach(); on a closed window or a moved screen epoch ScopedApp::update returns Gone, send_box.sound.finish never runs, the path stays Read::Reading, is_unread is false so it is never re-read, tray_videos_checking stays true and Send says 'Checking the video, send again' until the file is removed from the tray
fix: Hold the read's Task in Read::Reading (dropped with the entry) or settle/forget Reading entries when the window or screen scope goes (a dropped continuation owes its cleanup); app-level reads must not use window/screen-scoped spawns

title: Closing the story composer while a post or save is in flight drops the request that would report it
trigger: Press Post (stage Posting{request}) or Save (Saving{request}), then press Esc, Close or click the backdrop before the answer lands
effect: close() resets the whole composer to default, so the Posting/Saving request is no longer tracked: a failed post or edit is never shown and a success never says so; reopening via the + tile also wipes session post outcomes
fix: Keep the stage in a value owned by StoryUi that survives close (or disable close while ComposerStage::busy), and report its outcome as a note

title: A manual Check over "Updated to Quill X" replaces Installed without acknowledging the changelog
trigger: After an update the Installed banner shows; in Settings press Check for updates (UpdateControl::of maps Installed to Check{busy:false}, so check_for_updates accepts it).
effect: State goes Installed -> Checking -> UpToDate; the changelog receipt is never acknowledged, so the banner/What's new comes back at the next launch. recheck_for_updates guards this for the timer only.
fix: Guard Installed inside check_for_updates (one place), or make Check unavailable while Installed
